metadata.title: Offset Docks
metadata.description: Reveal 64%. Two offset hooked piers face opposite ways. Build a northern or southern return around them; a wall cannot reconnect a cut. Two field enemies retain their pockets, and the outer patrol also threatens the border. The enemy-slow pickup is an optional detour. Tap a direction to move. Closing a cut stops the craft; choose a fresh direction to continue.
metadata.author: RevealLine
metadata.rightsStatus: Original abstract source geometry. Existing procedural preview presentation; no new artwork, stories or music.

classRecipes.label: Scout
classRecipes.description: Mark hidden objectives permanently; show enemy direction hints for four seconds. No slowing.

classRecipes.label: Light carrier
classRecipes.description: Pick up one charge at a supply pad; drop a field that stuns nearby field enemies.

classRecipes.label: Heavy carrier
classRecipes.description: Carry two charges; each creates the same temporary stun field.

classRecipes.label: Interceptor
classRecipes.description: Absorb one enemy or lane contact: cancel the cut and recover at spawn without losing a life. Self-crossing remains dangerous.

classRecipes.label: Fiber relay
classRecipes.description: Ignore signal interference and scan for hidden relays. Your cable is the live trail: enemy contact still breaks it.

classRecipes.label: Impact craft
classRecipes.description: Release a close-range stun pulse, abandon the unfinished cut and redeploy at home without losing a life. The pulse never captures territory.

classRecipes.label: Trapper
classRecipes.description: Pick up one charge and place a four-second field that slows field enemies to one quarter speed.

metadata.title: Sandbar Braid
metadata.description: Reveal 66%. Four staggered sandbars leave an open center and unequal outer detours. Choose which crossings to secure first. A warned interceptor commits to its marked route; use the warning to change your approach. The middle patch slows your craft; the remote speed pickup is optional. A closed cut stops the craft. A fresh direction starts the next leg.

metadata.title: Crossing Watch
metadata.description: Reveal 68%. Two stationary sentries warn along one horizontal and one vertical lane. Their different schedules create crossing and waiting choices around two unequal islands. Watch both warnings before extending a cut; a wall is not a safe cut endpoint. An outer freeze pickup is optional. Each closure stops your craft until you choose a fresh direction.
